name: Bard
subtitle: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation
multiclassTraits: Gain the Hit Point Die, proficiency in one skill of your choice, proficiency with one Musical Instrument, and training with Light armor.

coreTraits.label: Starting Equipment
coreTraits.value: Choose A or B: (A) Leather Armor, 2 Daggers, Musical Instrument of your choice, Entertainer's Pack, and 19 GP; or (B) 90 GP

features.title: Bardic Inspiration
features.body:
You can supernaturally inspire others through words, music, or dance, represented by your Bardic Inspiration die (a d6).


Using Bardic Inspiration. As a Bonus Action, inspire a creature within 60 feet that can see or hear you. That creature gains one Bardic Inspiration die. Once within the next hour, when the creature fails a D20 Test, it can roll the die and add it to the d20, potentially turning a failure into a success. The die is expended when rolled.


Number of Uses. You can confer a Bardic Inspiration die a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum once), regaining all uses on a Long Rest.


At Higher Levels. The die becomes a d8 at level 5, a d10 at level 10, and a d12 at level 15.

features.title: Spellcasting
features.body:
You have learned to cast spells through your bardic arts. Charisma is your spellcasting ability and you can use a Musical Instrument as a Spellcasting Focus.


Cantrips. You know two cantrips of your choice from the Bard spell list. Dancing Lights and Vicious Mockery are recommended. You gain more cantrips at levels 4 and 10.


Prepared Spells. Choose four level 1 spells from the Bard spell list to start. The number increases as you gain levels. Charm Person, Color Spray, Dissonant Whispers, and Healing Word are recommended.


Changing Your Prepared Spells. Whenever you gain a Bard level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Bard spell for which you have spell slots.

features.title: Expertise
features.body: You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice. Performance and Persuasion are recommended. At Bard level 9, you gain Expertise in two more skills.

features.title: Jack of All Trades
features.body: You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (round down) to any ability check you make that uses a skill proficiency you lack and that doesn't otherwise use your Proficiency Bonus.

features.title: Bard Subclass
features.body: You gain a Bard subclass of your choice. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Bard level or lower. Choose your college below:

features.title: Ability Score Improvement
features.body: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Bard levels 8, 12, 16, and 19.

features.title: Font of Inspiration
features.body: You now regain all your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a Short or Long Rest. In addition, you can expend a spell slot (no action required) to regain one expended use of Bardic Inspiration.

features.title: Subclass Feature
features.body: You gain a new feature from your chosen college.

features.title: Countercharm
features.body: If you or a creature within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw against an effect that applies the Charmed or Frightened condition, you can take a Reaction to cause the save to be rerolled, and the new roll has Advantage.

features.title: Ability Score Improvement
features.body: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.title: Expertise
features.body: You gain Expertise in two more of your skill proficiencies of your choice.

features.title: Magical Secrets
features.body: Whenever you reach a Bard level and the Prepared Spells number increases, you can choose any of your new prepared spells from the Bard, Cleric, Druid, and Wizard spell lists. The chosen spells count as Bard spells for you. Whenever you replace a prepared spell, you can replace it with a spell from those lists.

features.title: Ability Score Improvement
features.body: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.title: Subclass Feature
features.body: You gain a new feature from your chosen college.

features.title: Ability Score Improvement
features.body: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.title: Superior Inspiration
features.body: When you roll Initiative, you regain expended uses of Bardic Inspiration until you have two if you have fewer than that.

features.title: Epic Boon
features.body: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Spell Recall is recommended.

features.title: Words of Creation
features.body: You always have the Power Word: Heal and Power Word: Kill spells prepared. When you cast either spell, you can target a second creature with it if that creature is within 10 feet of the first target.
